name: Tomato and Grilled Bell Pepper soup
description: Can be prepared the night before and kept frozen for a week or two.

instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 10 tomatoes; 2 red bell peppers; 2 onions; 1 clove of garlic; 1L stock or broth; ¾t Cayenne pepper; 1t paprika powder; 3t bruschetta herbs; 1t oregano; 1t giner syrup; 2T olive oil; 2T heavy cream. Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Set out the bowls, pans, measuring tools, and any baking equipment named in the steps below. Wash any fresh produce before use. Keep raw eggs, meat, and their utensils separate from ready-to-eat food.
Halve, deseed and grill the bell peppers in an oven or on a grill.

Sauté onion and crushed garlic in a large soup pan with olive oil. Stir frequently so the ingredients soften evenly without sticking or burning; reduce the heat if they darken too quickly. For this stovetop step, start over medium heat and lower it if the food browns before the center cooks.
Add broth/stock, tomatoes, bell paper and purée with a stick blender.

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.

keywords: tomato and grilled bell pepper soup

source.author: Thijs Wester
source.originalInstructions:
1. Halve, deseed and grill the bell peppers in an oven or on a grill. Remove skin after grilling.
2. Skin and quarter tomatoes.
3. Sauté onion and crushed garlic in a large soup pan with olive oil.
4. Add broth/stock, tomatoes, bell paper and purée with a stick blender.
5. Add spices, syrup and cream.
